additionalCompatibility.reason: All three tested title inputs are fixed-source parse-invalid yet current native accepts them. Old expected raw EM_TITLE positive value is not reached by original: terminal EM_ID shadows title; hidden EM_WS consumes preceding whitespace. Do not count its failing value assertion as a valid title-output feature gap. Acceptance/rejection divergence remains real.
sourceAnalysis: The entry permits title=EM_TITLE (line11); EM_TITLE is declared at line62, but a declaration is not evidence that these inputs produce that token.

EM_ID regex at line54 matches the leading word title. DefaultTokenBuilder lines56-59 appends terminal tokens in defined order; buildTerminalTokens lines76-78 retains that order. EM_ID precedes EM_TITLE.

Hidden EM_WS at line64 is /\s+/: from the newline immediately after eventmodeling it greedily consumes the newline plus following space/tab indentation in these two probes. At the next token boundary the lexer sees title, not its former leading whitespace. Thus the attempted whitespace workaround does not reach EM_TITLE.

The observed exact parser failures are line2,column1 for unindented title and line2,column2 for space/tab variants, all expecting EOF and finding title. The attempted terminal converter was never reached.

CommonValueConverter rulesRegexes only recognizes TITLE/ACC_TITLE/ACC_DESCR, not prefixed EM_TITLE. DefaultValueConverter would return an unrecognized string terminal unchanged IF it were actually recognized; that conditional source fact does not make these three tested inputs legal.
